Performance cannot be assessed from photos. No benchmark or system specs are visible.
The screen is on and shows a desktop, but internal components, battery, ports, and peripherals are not tested. No proof of full functionality.
The exterior appears clean, but internal cleanliness and speed are not visible. No system specs or performance data provided.
No serial number, warranty sticker, or proof of origin is visible. The term 'original' is subjective and cannot be verified remotely.
